BC_description: Promise.promisify and Promise.promisifyAll now by default only use the first argument passed to the callback adapter to resolve the promise. Previously in 2.x, these methods would construct an array of all arguments when more than one argument was passed to the callback adapter.
Adaptation_method: If you need to access all callback arguments, use the new multiArgs option: `Promise.promisify(fn, {multiArgs: true})`, `Promise.promisifyAll(obj, {multiArgs: true})`, or `Promise.fromCallback(fn, {multiArgs: true})`.
